name: base
description: The core engineering team for the claude-md config: 25 least-privilege agents (planning, review, implementation, debugging, testing, devops, ops triage, docs, and curated stack experts) plus 6 skills — /caveman (terse output), secure-code-reviewer (OWASP audit), work-quality-checker (pre-send executive QA), regression-guard (fix-once: REGRESSIONS.md ledger + guard run before done), and setup-advisor (recommends trusted, additive installs with evidence and token cost; installs only on approval), requirements-gate (multi-step asks: AC list, clarify pop-up, AC → evidence before done) — and the /implement-plan command (execute a plan file end-to-end via pack subagents, ledger-aware, AC-audited by the read-only completion-auditor, resume-safe) and /spec (interview → specs/<slug>.md). Zero-network; ships one static, no-network SessionStart hook (a working-agreement reminder at startup, /clear and compaction) — no other scripts, no file access. Install the security baseline (settings.json) separately; see setup.md.
